_comment: 30 additional labeled issues. Combined with the 20 in db/seed/fixtures.json this gives the Agent Society benchmark its 50-issue set. Kept compact; each has ground-truth expected_classification and a golden_response (maintainer voice) for the voice-similarity metric. duplicate_of points at an issue in the main fixtures or here.

issues.title: TypeError: cannot read property 'length' of undefined in parse()
issues.body: Calling parse() on an empty buffer throws `TypeError: cannot read property 'length' of undefined`. v2.4.1, node 20.
issues.author: dev-a
issues.golden_response: Thanks for the report — we should guard the empty-buffer case in `parse()` and return a clear ParseError. I'll get that in.

issues.title: Add a --quiet flag to the CLI
issues.body: Could the CLI get a --quiet flag to suppress progress output in CI?
issues.author: dev-b
issues.golden_response: Reasonable — a --quiet flag in `src/cli.ts` is a small addition. PR welcome if you'd like to take it.

issues.title: How do I parse from a string instead of a file?
issues.body: Is there a way to call parse on a string directly rather than reading from disk?
issues.author: dev-c
issues.golden_response: Yes — `parse(Buffer.from(yourString))` works directly. I'll make that clearer in the docs.

issues.title: plz help broken
issues.body: broken plz help
issues.author: dev-d
issues.golden_response: Happy to help — could you share the version, the exact input, and the error you're seeing? A minimal repro would go a long way.

issues.title: 💰 Make $$$ working from home — click now
issues.body: Earn money fast!!! Visit my-spam-site.example now!!!
issues.author: spammer-x

issues.title: Parser drops the last record when file has no trailing newline
issues.body: If the .lane file doesn't end with a newline, the final record is silently dropped. v2.4.0.
issues.author: dev-e
issues.golden_response: Good catch — we're treating the newline as a record terminator instead of a separator. I'll fix the final-record handling and add a test.

issues.title: Support gzip-compressed .lane.gz files
issues.body: Would be great if the loader could read .lane.gz directly.
issues.author: dev-f
issues.golden_response: Nice idea — I'd add transparent gzip detection in the loader behind the existing read abstraction. Keeping it optional. PR welcome.

issues.title: Crash with no message on a file that begins with a NUL
issues.body: App dies with no output when the input file's first byte is a null. v2.4.1.
issues.author: dev-g
issues.golden_response: This is the same crash as #101 (leading null byte). Closing as a duplicate — let's track the fix there.

issues.title: Memory leak on repeated parse() calls in a loop
issues.body: Calling parse() in a tight loop slowly grows RSS. Looks like buffers aren't released.
issues.author: dev-h
issues.golden_response: Thanks — that points at us holding references across calls. I'll check the buffer lifecycle in the parser and follow up.

issues.title: Is there TypeScript types support?
issues.body: Does the package ship .d.ts type definitions?
issues.author: dev-i
issues.golden_response: Yes, types ship in the package. If your editor isn't picking them up, check your moduleResolution — happy to help debug.

issues.title: Add JSON schema validation for parsed output
issues.body: It'd help to validate parsed records against a schema.
issues.author: dev-j
issues.golden_response: Reasonable enhancement — I'd keep validation optional and pluggable so we don't force a schema lib on everyone.

issues.title: Regression: 2.4.0 is 3x slower than 2.3.9 on large files
issues.body: After upgrading to 2.4.0, parsing a 200MB file went from 2s to 6s. Profiling points at the new lexer path.
issues.author: dev-k
issues.golden_response: Thanks for benchmarking it — a 3x regression is serious. I'll profile the new lexer path against 2.3.9 and find where we regressed.

issues.title: Doesn't compile on Node 22
issues.body: npm install fails to build the native addon on Node 22. Works on 20.
issues.author: dev-l
issues.golden_response: Thanks — likely an N-API/ABI change on Node 22. I'll bump the build config and add Node 22 to CI.

issues.title: How to disable the progress bar?
issues.body: The progress bar clutters my logs. How do I turn it off?
issues.author: dev-m
issues.golden_response: Set `FASTLANE_NO_PROGRESS=1` or pass `{ progress: false }`. I'll document it more prominently.

issues.title: Add support for custom delimiters
issues.body: Our files use a pipe delimiter instead of comma. Could this be configurable?
issues.author: dev-n
issues.golden_response: Sensible — a `{ delimiter }` option on parse() would cover this. I'd default to comma to keep backward-compat.

issues.title: Hangs on a 1GB input via the CLI
issues.body: fastlane parse huge.lane never returns for a 1GB file. Have to kill it.
issues.author: dev-o
issues.golden_response: Same as #112 — the CLI buffers large files instead of streaming. Tracking the fix there; closing as a duplicate.

issues.title: NullPointer when 'date' field is missing
issues.body: Records without a date field cause a crash instead of leaving the date null.
issues.author: dev-p
issues.golden_response: Thanks — a missing optional field shouldn't crash. We should default `date` to null. I'll patch the field reader.

issues.title: Document the streaming API
issues.body: createParseStream() is barely documented. Could you add examples?
issues.author: dev-q
issues.golden_response: Agreed, the streaming docs are thin. I'll expand the section with a couple of end-to-end examples.

issues.title: Wrong line number reported in ParseError
issues.body: ParseError says line 1 even when the error is on line 42. Off-by-the-whole-file.
issues.author: dev-r
issues.golden_response: Thanks — the lexer isn't tracking newlines for error positions. I'll thread line numbers through so ParseError points at the real line.

issues.title: Can I use this in the browser?
issues.body: Does fastlane-parser work in the browser or is it Node-only?
issues.author: dev-s
issues.golden_response: The core parser is pure JS and works in the browser; only the CLI and fs helpers are Node-only. I'll note that in the README.

issues.title: Security: ReDoS in the header regex on crafted input
issues.body: A crafted header with many repeated characters causes catastrophic backtracking in the header regex, pinning a CPU. Potential DoS.
issues.author: sec-t
issues.golden_response: Thank you for the responsible report — agreed this is a security issue. I'll replace the vulnerable header regex with a linear scan and ship a patch promptly.

issues.title: Add an option to keep parsing after a malformed record
issues.body: Right now one bad record aborts the whole parse. Could there be a lenient mode that skips and collects errors?
issues.author: dev-u
issues.golden_response: I like this — a `{ lenient: true }` mode that collects errors and continues. Default stays strict. PR welcome.

issues.title: App just exits with no error on a weird first byte
issues.body: Program terminates instantly with no message when the file starts with a strange control character. 2.4.1.
issues.author: dev-v
issues.golden_response: This matches #101 (crash on a leading control/null byte). Closing as a duplicate; please follow #101 for the fix.

issues.title: Incorrect handling of escaped quotes inside values
issues.body: A value containing an escaped quote \" is parsed incorrectly, splitting the field.
issues.author: dev-w
issues.golden_response: Thanks for the example — our quote-escaping in the lexer is off. I'll fix the escaped-quote handling and add a test case.

issues.title: How to contribute a new output format?
issues.body: I'd like to add an output formatter. Where should it live?
issues.author: dev-x
issues.golden_response: Welcome! Formatters live in `src/format/`. Have a look at the JSON formatter as a template, and ping me on the PR — happy to guide.

issues.title: Provide prebuilt binaries to avoid native compile
issues.body: The native build fails on some CI images. Could you ship prebuilt binaries?
issues.author: dev-y
issues.golden_response: Good idea — prebuilt binaries via prebuildify would cut the native-compile pain. I'll scope it for the next minor.

issues.title: Unicode BOM at start of file breaks the header scan
issues.body: Files saved with a UTF-8 BOM fail the header check because the BOM bytes precede the magic.
issues.author: dev-z
issues.golden_response: Thanks — we should strip a UTF-8 BOM before the header scan. Easy fix in the lexer; I'll add it with a test.

issues.title: Add async iterator support to the stream API
issues.body: It'd be nice to `for await (const record of parseStream)`.
issues.author: dev-aa
issues.golden_response: Agreed — exposing the stream as an async iterable is clean and ergonomic. PR welcome, otherwise I'll add it.

issues.title: Dependency 'minimist' has a known CVE
issues.body: npm audit flags a CVE in a transitive minimist. Please bump.
issues.author: audit-bee
issues.golden_response: Thanks for flagging — I'll bump the dependency that pulls the old minimist and add an overrides entry. Advisory fixes go out quickly.

issues.title: Timezone-dependent test failures in date.test.ts
issues.body: The date tests pass in UTC CI but fail on my machine in PST. Likely the same UTC vs local issue.
issues.author: dev-bb
issues.golden_response: This is the same root cause as #110 (date parsed as UTC, formatted local). I'll fix it there and make the tests timezone-stable. Closing as a duplicate.
